selection: Exactly two new configurations plus reused49.28 control. Rank inner correct count, macro-F1, declared order. Full-data selection from cached inner predictions only.
features: Unchanged original MiniLM384 plus AV128; fixed age-free language16. No questionnaire/ID/label columns; no confidence filtering.
preprocessing: Training-fold StandardScaler/PCA16 on semanticAV512; separate language scaling with fixed0.5 weight. Shared projection fits all fitting people; each binary head fits only its two classes. Per-pair square-root class-frequency weights normalized to pair sample count.
architecture: Ten L2 binary logistic heads; complete-graph least-squares log-odds projection to five scores then softmax. No calibrated probability claim, hierarchy, threshold tuning or external labels.
capacity: 32 coordinates per head,330 coefficients/intercepts total; C=.001 or.01 to restrain fits with scarce classes. Shared projection avoids estimating a PCA from a tiny rare-class pair.
motivation: Retained control produces151 majority predictions among186 repeated Mild/Moderate cases; specialized class-pair boundaries may preserve minority contrasts. Prior hierarchy and RBF SVM failed; this is a different logistic loss/decomposition, not a claim that pairwise modeling was never previously used.
evaluation: Original163 people, same5 outer/3 inner folds, seeds42/137/2026. Fixed budget, no outer tuning or validation/test scoring; exploratory after long history.
stopping_rule: One model family,two configurations,no post-result expansion. At most135 nested pipeline fits (1350 binary heads) and2 full-training pipelines.
promotion_rule: Only a higher primary score on identical outer folds can be considered a best-observed candidate; require positive paired interval and fresh confirmation before claiming supported improvement. Preserve original49.28 regardless.
